title: Lydia Munce
clean_html:
Lydia Munce

Preserved Primary Document • munce-l1.htm

Lydia married Benjamin Sammons, a member of the mixed race Sammons family from Kent Co. and they had the following children: Annie Sammons Minnie Sammons Samuel Sammons Robert Sammons Elizabeth Sammons Susan Sammons (1867- ) married #1 Thomas Carney and #2 Jesse Dean
